audit.summary: Archived assessment: Major. Incorrect curvature coefficient changes the extension equation; Caccioppoli estimate has incompatible amplitude powers; Wrong sign for negative weight exponents
limitations: Incorrect curvature coefficient changes the extension equation — Counterevidence: Flat R=0 case unchanged; many bounded-potential estimates may survive.
Caccioppoli estimate has incompatible amplitude powers — Counterevidence: No demonstrated damage to the later geometric conclusions from this local error; corrected local energy estimate supplied.
Wrong sign for negative weight exponents — Counterevidence: Later inspected frequency calculations retain signed a instead of invoking nonnegativity.

High-order extension needs jet matching and precise smallness — Counterevidence: Lemma 2.19, equations (2.42)-(2.43) on p.14, states arbitrary-order C^{k,alpha} estimates whose proof explicitly describes them as holding across the doubled boundary. The primary verifier actually viewed that page. If applicable with that two-sided regularity, evenness of U forces the relevant odd normal jets to vanish and removes the conditional jet obstruction. These assertions require reconciliation with finite smoothness in Remark 2.20 (p.15) and the high-order approximation discussion in Remark 4.21 (p.43). Their relationship has not been resolved here; no admissible counterexample has been established.
Limitations: External regularity/stability theorems not fully reproved
Limitations: No admissible PE counterexample to high-order extension
The finding applies to the exact reviewed source version and inspected scope; uninspected publication versions are not adjudicated.
The report retains counterevidence and unresolved questions. Publication does not repeat scientific review.
Independent human scientific adjudication remains pending; author adoption has not been requested.

proposition.claim:
Recorded check: Incorrect curvature coefficient changes the extension equation

n=3,a=0,s=2; complete Ric=-3g, smooth round infinity, exact FG condition and boundary ratio; smooth finite-energy U; spectral gap 9/4>2. Proposition 2.13 permits smooth arbitrary f. No assertion f=1 is locally P_1-harmonic.

Recorded check: Caccioppoli estimate has incompatible amplitude powers

Local ball energy solution and finite integrals; not a counterexample to global Schwartz/energy assumptions.

Recorded check: Wrong sign for negative weight exponents

Admitted parameter range and geometric inward ray; no solution assumption needed.

Recorded check: High-order extension needs jet matching and precise smallness

No actual PE/PDE/frequency-normalized solution with a nonzero offending jet constructed; conditional polynomial is not a counterexample.
